name: Mullet River
blurb: Mullet River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: A dam lies near a section endpoint (Mullet Creek). The landing’s position relative to the barrier still needs confirmation.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Mullet Creek and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

gaugeContext.note: This station is downstream of the accessed reach. Its readings are reference information, not a measured flow for every section or a float-time estimate.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS Water Data — monitoring location and Wisconsin gauge review
